title: Aromatic Roasted Thai Tofu Gaeng Curry
description: A low-carb and romantic Thai dish featuring roasted tofu and soya milk, served on a cedar plank. This gaeng curry is a perfect dinner option for those looking for a flavorful and healthy meal.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, whisk together soya milk, shio-koji, thai red curry paste, fish sauce, lime juice, brown sugar, salt, and black pepper.
Add the tofu cubes to the bowl and marinate for at least 30 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the marinade and place it on a cedar plank lined with parchment paper.
Drizzle the coconut oil over the tofu and roast in the oven for 20 minutes.
While the tofu is roasting, simmer the marinade in a saucepan over medium heat until it thickens into a gaeng curry sauce.
Once the tofu is done, remove it from the oven and brush it with the gaeng curry sauce.
Return the tofu to the oven and roast for an additional 5 minutes.
Remove the tofu from the oven and serve it on the cedar plank, garnished with fresh herbs if desired.
